entities.name: Jyoti
entities.description: A legendary ancient elemental of the plane of Moag, a large golem-like being of stone and vegetation.

entities.name: Dryads of Moag
entities.description: The Dryads of Moag's plane, with whom Jyoti has a bond.

relations.note: Jyoti has a bond with the Dryads of the plane.
relations.quote: It has a bond with the Dryads of the plane
